description: Fairy Music v1.0.9: Massive Performance Boost, Background Announcements & Ultra-Light 70MB Build.
changelog: Background Push Announcements: Receive real-time announcements directly on your device even when the app is closed
Ultra-Light 70MB Build: 42% APK size reduction (from 118MB to 70MB) via R8 optimization and dead code stripping
Zero-Jank Butter-Smooth UI: 0.00% frame drops and 200MB+ RAM freed during scrolling and playback
In-App Feedback: Send suggestions and bug reports directly from Settings & About screens
Fixed UI recomposition thrashing and optimized image caching memory footprint
